summary: Three demonstrated core theoretical defects: nonaffine spline construction, nonzero conditional cross term under full-data clipping, and zero-variation risk bound omitting parametric error.

problems.title: Lemma C.7 constructs a quadratic rather than a linear spline
problems.claim: Case2 claims s(z)=g(z)+(h(z)-g(z))(z-a)/(b-a) belongs to S(K).
assumptions: g=max(0,z-1/2) and h=max(5/4,1+z); legitimate F-space members; g<h throughout, no crossover.
problems.check: Follow proof base case and Case2 exactly. On [1/4,1/2], s=4z^2+3z-1; values 0,11/16,3/2 at equally spaced grid points.
problems.result: Midpoint is 1/16 below endpoint average; function not in S(K).
problems.counterevidence: Convex mixing ensures sandwich but not linearity. Existence lemma itself may be true; endpoint line works locally.
problems.impact: Invalid construction directly used to control Theorem6.2 approximation term; no claim impossible optimal rate.

correction.statement: Endpoint interpolation 6z-3/2 works for this interval; full discontinuity/collision induction not verified.

problems.title: Current-response clipping invalidates the martingale conditional identity
problems.claim: LemmaD.6(1) conditional excess noisy loss equals conditional squared prediction error.
assumptions: n3,sigma.1,delta.1,theta(-1,1,1),uniform design; bounded continuous f with C6.
Condition past near(-1,1) and all noise magnitudes<=a=.3094347021; positive probability neighborhood.
problems.check: At representative past, raw prediction3; full-data B=2+max(epsilon3,0)<3, z3=B. Conditional cross term gives LHS-RHS=-E[epsilon3²|abs(epsilon3)<=a].
problems.result: Difference=-0.00979384906475712, strictly negative and persists near the history.
problems.counterevidence: Symmetric truncated noise remains mean-zero but prediction depends on its value; fixed/predictable B is a different algorithm/assumption. The counterexample uses Equation (1)'s Gaussian response model and Section 3.1's |f|<=1. Algorithm 3 p12 annotates response histories [0,1], incompatible with the stated Gaussian model; enforcing that extra restriction excludes data covered by the theorem rather than restoring D.6 for its declared model.
problems.impact: D8 martingale justification fails, affecting ADDLE proof and downstream AKORN knot guarantee.

correction.statement: A full revised concentration argument or changed predictable/deterministic clipping requires proof.

problems.title: Risk theorem lacks the necessary parametric baseline at C=0
problems.claim: Theorem6.2 MSE=Otilde(n^-4/5 C^2/5) for all C<infinity; corresponding ADDLE total bound.
assumptions: Every selected spline space contains constants; projection is least squares.
problems.check: Pathwise mean of fitted vector equals sample mean epsilon; MSE>=sample_mean(epsilon)^2>0 a.s. Stated bound0. Online constant f=.5 has first prediction0 and loss>=.25.
problems.result: Literal central uniform theorem cannot hold on permitted affine signals.
problems.counterevidence: C1 retains max{...,1}; experiments discuss parametric1/n. This supports an intended omitted baseline but does not change the theorem's domain.
problems.impact: Central theorem statement false on included domain; no refutation of positive-C exponent.

correction.statement: Retain a parametric1/n term offline; full repaired theorem not verified given P1/P2.

repair_verification: Local endpoint interpolation only; full theorem repair not verified.
limitations: AppendixE full approximation analysis and AppendixF nonuniform extensions not exhaustively checked.
External cited proofs and later revisions not independently verified.
Frozen release differs from printed estimator and historical run provenance unresolved.
